name: the-loom
title: The Loom
description: A table loom in SVG. Warp threads run the length of the bed, the heddle lifts every other one, and the boat shuttle flies the weft across; the beater packs the row home and the finished cloth grows toward the reader row by row. One number is the weave, and the shuttle's travel, the heddle's lift, the beater's swing and the cloth are all that same number read four ways. It runs its own loop with a play/pause control, and once paused you can run the shuttle or drive it with the arrow keys.
